sqlReview.title: SQL 查詢審核
sqlReview.sql: SELECT TA004 AS 部門, TB017 AS 會計科目, SUM(TB013) AS 未稅金額, SUM(TB014) AS 稅額 FROM [DSCSYS].[dbo].[ACPTA] JOIN [DSCSYS].[dbo].[ACPTB] ON TA001 = TB001 AND TA002 = TB002 WHERE TA003 >= '20260101' AND TA003 <= '20260331' AND TA018 <> 'Y' AND TA024 = 'Y' GROUP BY TA004, TB017
